# apple_remove_build_from_beta_groups (Action)

Removes a build from beta groups, so their testers can no longer install it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
action "apple_remove_build_from_beta_groups" "public" {
  config {
    build_id       = data.apple_build.latest.id
    beta_group_ids = [apple_beta_group.public.id]
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `beta_group_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the beta groups.
- `build_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the build, e.g. `data.apple_build.latest.id`.
